rationale: Measured hotspots are already isolated behind C# providers; a full UI or engine rewrite has no demonstrated user benefit and would replace tested cleanup safeguards.

rollback.scanProvider: Set CDRIVE_SCAN_PROVIDER=legacy to restore filesystem enumeration.
rollback.moduleBoundary: Each core module is dot-sourced and can be reverted independently while preserving stable IDs and event schemas.
rollback.release: Rollback is a new semantic version built from the last validated contracts; published tags and releases are never overwritten.
